categories.name: Single perturbation
categories.description: 10 image perturbations, each at three parameter settings (30 conditions).

categories.name: Off-the-shelf model-based editing and removal
categories.description: Prompt-based editing (Qwen-Image-Edit, FLUX.2-klein), VAE regeneration (2 settings), diffusion regeneration (3 settings) and UnMarker (8 conditions).

categories.name: Multiple perturbations
categories.description: 8 fixed sequences of image perturbations; the output of each step is the input to the next.

categories.name: Model-based attack followed by multiple perturbations
categories.paper_heading: 4. Combining 'Off-the-shelf' Model-based Attacks and Multiple Perturbations
categories.description: 6 fixed sequences that start with a model-based attack followed by further perturbations.

mean_asi_columns.post_hoc_synthetic_matched: Paper: 'Mean ASI, post-hoc (synthetic)' -- averaged over images and the 11 post-hoc methods on the matched synthetic cohort (tab_attackgrid / tab_chains caption).
mean_asi_columns.in_generation_synthetic_matched: Paper: 'Mean ASI, in-generation (synthetic)' -- averaged over images and the 4 in-generation methods on the same cohort.
mean_asi_columns.post_hoc_manipulated: Paper (chains only): 'Mean ASI' column of tab_synergy, measured on the manipulated category.
mean_asi_columns.mean_asi_computed: Computed by build_data.py from robust_curves.csv as the mean over methods of the condition-level mean ASI; synthetic_post_hoc pools the two synthetic identity arms (1,593 images) per method by n_pos. The two synthetic_matched values reproduce the paper columns.

asi_definition: ASI (attack-strength index) = LPIPS distance between the attacked image and its pre-attack image, per image. Cropped images are scaled back to the reference size; rotated images keep their transformed canvas.
